summary: Same-agent review,not independent: native user-default metadata and original/effective separation reuse one canonical entry operation; secondary clones use master and Put preserves native defaults. Bounded verification passes.
findings: Reviewed eight pinned native source blobs and current implementation; existing binder tokens differ only in master operands,Put only changes its clone call,and ordinary holder delegates without changing borrowed arguments. Existing other method bodies retain emitted tokens.
residual_risks: Sc document/style consumers,connected UI and same-model ODS remain unimplemented; broad parity is not claimed. No native lifetime/cache/allocator outcomes or first-create failure cleanup are simulated.
